summary: Iteration 9 frontend-only verification of Kavip-style /account restyle (mobile 400x850 + desktop 1400x900 regression) and /orders detail drawer changes. All 4 acceptance criteria PASS.

mobile_account_400x850.title_underline: h1 '我的帳戶' has 2 spans (text + md:hidden orange underline). Underline present but visually subtle on cream bg
mobile_account_400x850.panel_wrapper: Panel container background is transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) on mobile — no white panel wrapper as required
mobile_account_400x850.card_tags_absolute: All 4 tags (帳戶基礎資訊/帳戶綁定訊息/個人聯絡資訊/帳戶密碼修改) have position:absolute, tagLeft==cardLeft, tagTop==cardTop (top-left corner)
mobile_account_400x850.no_overlap: Card1 tag.bottom=304 vs first row.top=320 (16px gap); card padding-top=48px — content clears tag
mobile_account_400x850.delete_pill: delete-account-btn present inline next to account-no (105908808); NOT clicked
mobile_account_400x850.gender_toggle_and_save: Clicked profile-gender-female then profile-save → toast '已儲存' appeared (via sonner)

desktop_account_1400x900.white_panel: Panel bg = rgb(255,255,255), panelX=356 (right of sidebar)
desktop_account_1400x900.boxes_two_column: 4 boxes rendered in grid lg:grid-cols-2 with gray bg (rgb(248,250,252) = slate-50)
desktop_account_1400x900.tags_inline: All 4 tags have position:static (NOT absolute) — inline label chips as expected

mobile_orders_drawer_400x850.drawer_opens: order-detail-drawer opens after clicking an order card
mobile_orders_drawer_400x850.removed_rows: has_rechargeAccount=false, has_contact=false (充值帳號/聯絡方式 removed)
mobile_orders_drawer_400x850.footer_buttons: order-detail-view-orders (查看訂單) + order-detail-home-btn (返回首頁) side-by-side with IDENTICAL class 'flex-1 h-11 rounded-full bg-white border border-orange-300 text-orange-500 font-semibold text-sm'
mobile_orders_drawer_400x850.home_pill_top: order-detail-home-top-btn (首頁 pill) present at top-left of drawer header
mobile_orders_drawer_400x850.home_nav: Clicking 返回首頁 closed drawer and navigated to '/' (verified via page.url)

critical_code_review_comments: AccountLayout.jsx L18: the mobile title underline uses bg-orange-200/80 at bottom-0.5 h-2 — visible in DOM but visually subtle against the cream page. Consider stronger shade (orange-300) or increased height for better emphasis if desired (non-blocking).

MyAccount.jsx L53 Row uses flex-wrap, causing the gray '可用於登入' hint to wrap under the email on mobile. This matches the request ('gray hints visible') but produces a 2-row 信箱 field; acceptable per spec.

MyOrders.jsx L221-223: OrderInfoForm renders only for ['paid','pending_payment']; drawer footer buttons (查看訂單/返回首頁) always render regardless of status — fine, both share identical styling as spec requires.
